summary: Completed testing of Stay Modification bug fixes (Extend Stay and Early Checkout). All 9 backend tests pass. Frontend UI testing confirms all 4 reported bugs are fixed: 1) Extend Stay and Early Checkout modals work without frontend errors, 2) Extend Stay correctly blocks conflicts with other bookings, 3) Early Checkout uses customer's booked rate (not room's default rate), 4) Numbers are properly formatted with Math.round() and toLocaleString().
critical_code_review_comments: Extend Stay endpoint correctly uses check_room_availability_for_booking() with skip_occupied_check=True for current occupant
Early Checkout correctly calculates customer_rate_per_night from original_room_charges / planned_nights instead of using room's default rate
Checkout preview endpoint also uses customer's booked rate for consistency
Frontend uses Math.round() and toLocaleString() for clean number formatting in Early Checkout modal
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created with TEST_ prefix for conflict testing (TEST_ConflictGuest, TEST_ConflictGuest2)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 stay modification bugs verified fixed: 1) Extend Stay modal works - shows guest info, current charges, date picker, 2) Extend Stay conflict check works - blocks extension when conflicting booking exists with clear error message, 3) Early Checkout uses customer's booked rate (e.g., Mohamed's rate is LKR 10,214/night = 71,500/7 nights, not room's default 11,500), 4) Numbers formatted with thousand separators (LKR 71,500, LKR 61,286). Checked-in customers: Mohamed (101), Alam (201), Kushid (203), Pim (205).
